The Narration of Ummul Mu'mineen Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates that when (her father) Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was on his deathbed, he appointed Hadhrat Umar (RA) as his successor. Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Talha (RA) then came to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and asked him who he had appointed as his successor. When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) informed them that he had appointed Hadhrat Umar (RA), they said, "What reply will you then give to your Rabb?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "Do you wish to make me fear Allaah? I know Allaah and Umar better then the two of you. I shall say to Allaah that I have appointed over them the best of His creation as my successor." [^2]
The narration of Hadhrat Zaid bin Haarith (RA)

Hadhrat Zaid bin Haarith (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was on his deathbed, he sent for Hadhrat Umar (RA) to appoint him as his successor. Some people commented, "You wish to appoint Umar as your successor when he is harsh and ill-tempered? When he becomes our leader, he will be even more harsh and ill-tempered. What reply will you give to your Rabb when you meet Him after appointing Umar as your successor over us?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "Do you wish to make me fear Allaah?! I shall say, 'O Allaah! I have appointed the best of Your creation as my successor over the people'." [^3]
Appointing a Consultative Assembly of Competent People to Decide who Should be the Khalifah
The Assassination of Hadhrat Umar (RA) and His Selecting Six Persons to Decide who Should be Khalifah

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that when Abu Lu'lu'ah attacked Hadhrat Umar (RA), he stabbed him twice with his spear. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then thought that he had perhaps wronged the people in a manner that he was unaware of. He therefore sent for Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA), whom he was very fond of. Hadhrat Umar (RA) always kept Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) in close confidence and would listen to what he had to say.
